name: beatsync-sonicsync
description: BeatSync / SonicSync — Multi-phone wireless synchronized audio speaker system

scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const opts = { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }; spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'server', 'run', 'dev'], opts); spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'client', 'run', 'dev'], opts);"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install

author: Nandan
